adds.title: The Daily Bugle#8
adds.text: Asked to say what is wrong with Spider-Man, Betty instead defends Peter as her friend and a very nice person, until Jameson's ranting cuts her off.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Betty defends on air as a very nice person.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who defends Peter on air before Jameson cuts her off.
adds.evidence: TikTok post 2 of the No Way Home campaign (8th video overall, 24 Nov 2021): 'Betty Brant instead defends him, claiming that Peter Parker is her friend and is actually a very nice person. Her opinion is cut short and replaced with footage of J. Jonah Jameson ranting.' (Post 11, #17, is also a sit-down interview with Peter.)

adds.title: The Daily Bugle#13
adds.text: Flash tells Betty about his new book on his relationship with Peter and claims he was the first to call him Spider-Man.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A classmate Flash writes a book about, claiming he named Spider-Man.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A classmate who writes a book about Peter and claims he named Spider-Man.
adds.evidence: TikTok post 7 (13th video overall, 10 Dec 2021): Betty interviews Flash, who 'has published a book about his relationship with Peter Parker and having been the first to dub him as Spider-Man'.

adds.title: The Daily Bugle#4
adds.text: Jameson airs the second part of Mysterio's video, which names Peter Parker as Spider-Man, and brands him a criminal menace.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The hero Jameson unmasks on air as a menace.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The host who airs Peter's unmasking and brands him a menace.
adds.evidence: Video 4 'Spider-Man Unmasked' (30 Oct 2019): 'Jameson presents the second part of Mysterio's video, exposing Spider-Man's real identity as Peter Parker and a criminal menace.' Later videos (#14, #17) have Jameson vowing to uncover Peter's 'web of lies'.

adds.title: Agatha All Along#1
adds.text: Three years on, Agatha is still trapped under Wanda's spell in Westview, living as the detective Agnes O'Connor until the spell breaks.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The witch whose spell still traps Agatha as Agnes.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A witch still trapped under Wanda's spell, living as Agnes.
adds.evidence: Episode 1 'Seekest Thou the Road': 'Three years after her defeat by Wanda Maximoff, the witch Agatha Harkness is still trapped under Wanda's spell in Westview'; the Jane Doe corpse she investigates has scarlet red hair and Rio tells her she is 'under the spell of the Scarlet Witch'. Wanda herself is not on screen in person (voice only in #6), hence medium.

adds.title: Agatha All Along#6
adds.text: As the Hex falls, Billy's soul passes into William Kaplan's body. Years later he learns of Wanda's twin sons and realizes he is her son Billy.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Billy's mother. He realizes he is the son she lost.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Wanda's son, reborn in William Kaplan's body.
adds.evidence: Episode 6 'Familiar by Thy Side': as the Hex Wanda created collapses, 'Billy Maximoff's soul enters William's body'; Ralph Bohner tells him 'about Wanda and Vision's twins Billy and Tommy, making William realize he is actually Billy.' Wanda is credited (voice) in the episode.

adds.title: Ms. Marvel#6
adds.text: Kamala's bangle glows and she switches places with Carol, who suddenly finds herself in Kamala's bedroom.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A young fan who switches places with Carol.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Kamala's hero, who switches places with her.
adds.evidence: 'No Normal' mid-credits scene: 'the bangle emits a strange glow before Kamala switches places with Danvers.' Kamala is a Captain Marvel fangirl throughout. Kind kept as mentor to match The Marvels stage; this is their first real link, so medium.

owner_calls.title: Marvel Zombies
owner_calls.question: In Paris (Marvel Zombies#4) the heroes, Peter among them, kill the zombie Hawkeye. Kamala's tie with the Zombie Avengers already got an MZ#4 stage for that group action. Add the same kind of stage for Peter, or leave it as a shared battle?
options: Add enemy, Marvel Zombies#4: 'In Paris, Peter and the other heroes cut down the zombie Hawkeye.'
Leave it: shared battle, no exchange
owner_calls.evidence: 'As the battle commences, the heroes lay waste to the horde, killing Hawkeye, Janet van Dyne, and Hank Pym... Spider-Man and Lang are being confronted by Wasp.'
